title: Study of leukemia stem cells in B-ALL
description: This study focused on the biologic properties of human B acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) stem cells. We used human leukemia cell lines, primary patient specimens, and patient derived xenografts in experiments using ChIP-seq, bulk RNA sequencing, single cell RNA sequencing, and CITE-seq.
